result.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: addGuests.handler.ts filters `guests` into `uniqueGuests` (excluding existing attendees and blacklisted emails), but then calls `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` with the raw, unfiltered `guests` array. In email-manager.ts, `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` routes such attendees to `AttendeeScheduledEmail` instead of `AttendeeAddGuestsEmail`. So a re-submitted existing attendee email (which the handler filtered out of the DB write) still causes that existing attendee to receive a full 'scheduled' email rather than the 'guests added' notice — incorrect
